findings.what: There are no fee numbers at all. The banks only show a date for their 'תעריפון', so I can't compare costs, which is the whole reason I came.
Every company has a long run of product words I don't know, and it's hard to tell which product is the account for buying funds.
The page is just names in two columns. No highlight, no 'start here', nothing for a beginner.
The fund-name list (BlackRock, Nasdaq…) has unexplained numbers, and you have to open folds to see anything.
Orange 'ללא תאריך פרסום' looks like a warning, but I don't know what it means for me.
